methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve monitor/display calibration devices spanning entry colorimeters to professional spectrophotometers from Datacolor, Calibrite, and X-Rite, verified 2026-08-09 against manufacturer product pages (datacolor.com, calibrite.com, xrite.com) and corroborating retailers (B&H, Amazon, Precision Camera, RPimaging, ephotozine); several manufacturer product pages render prices via JS and returned no static price, so priceUsd/priceNote instead reflect the clearest documented retailer figure with variance noted, and no image field is included for any entry because no directly-hosted, verifiably real product image URL could be confirmed for this roster within the available access.
